_comment: Vetting guidelines. Edit to taste. A profile is LIKED only if every enabled rule passes.

llm._comment: Local vision LLM (OpenAI-compatible endpoint). Only called for profiles that pass the rules above. Env LLM_URL/LLM_MODEL/LLM_ENABLED override.
llm.preferences: Prefer a clear, recent photo of one person (not a group, not heavily filtered, not a stock/celebrity image). Prefer a friendly, genuine bio. Reject profiles that look like spam, scams, or sex-work advertising.
